messages:
Sam (CS): Kicking off Deckhand 14-day pilot. Focus: embeddings for knowledge base + lightweight chat for internal helpdesk.
Pri (Deckhand PM): Hi! I'm PM. Noah is infra lead. We can provide ~6k docs and a small eval set. Main ask: low-latency for support queries and clear audit logs.
Kali (Solutions): Noted. Proposed success criteria: ingest 6k docs; median retrieval relevance >= 0.75; p95 chat latency < 600ms; <2% failed calls. Add a 3-scenario end-user spot-check.
Noah (Deckhand Infra): We'll need IP allowlist and service account. Can provide CIDR + certs by EOD day 1. Also want SIEM forwarding for audit.
Jade (Enablement): I'll run a 45-min rep training on Day 5 and a 20-min admin ops walkthrough Day 2. Please confirm attendees.
Pri (Deckhand PM): Attendees: support leads Maya and Omar; infra: Noah + security. Procurement wants a pilot cost ballpark.
Sam (CS): Action owners: Noah: networking + SIEM (day1). Kali: ingest script + sample mapping (day2). Jade: training invites (day2). Sam: cost estimate (day3).
Kali (Solutions): Ingest format: JSONL {id, text, source, metadata}. I'll post example CLI. Quick curl snippet: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/ingest -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" --data-binary @docs.jsonl```
Ops Bot: Onboarding board created: https://redwood.company/onboard/deckhand-pilot (team-only).
Sam (CS): Risk note: renewal risk if adoption < 50% or if accuracy < target after tuning. We'll schedule Day 8 mid-pilot review + Day 12 exec demo.
Pri (Deckhand PM): Confirmed. Upload eval set and expected answers to the board today.
Noah (Deckhand Infra): CIDR + certs posted.
Onboarding Bot: Reminder: Day 8 mid-pilot review scheduled (invite sent).
Sam (CS): Thanks team — I'll keep the board updated and follow up with finance for cost calc. Ping here for blockers. :rocket:
